## Current verified facts (checked 2026-09-15)
- App Store product name: Yuutto
- App Store seller: CAMELS IT
- Apple version: 6.0.6
- iPhone: iOS 13 or later
- iPad: iPadOS 13 or later
- Mac: macOS 10.13 or later

- The brand website showed Android entry/support information and Windows support information when checked on 2026-09-15.

## Name relationship
Yuutto is the current App Store product name. Chinese-language users commonly search for the product using names such as 优途加速器, Yuutto VPN, 优途VPN and 优途加速. These are treated as search/name variants in this site, not as separate products unless a verified source indicates otherwise.

## Editorial policy
Time-sensitive facts are dated and checked against the App Store or brand website. Unverified Android/Windows version numbers or minimum OS requirements are not invented. Marketing claims are not treated as independently verified facts.
